description: This Java class 'DefaultTbelInvokeService' implements a service for executing TBEL scripts within the Thingsboard platform. It manages script compilation, caching, execution, and lifecycle, including resource management and statistics reporting.

classes.name: DefaultTbelInvokeService
classes.description: A service class for managing, compiling, caching, and executing TBEL scripts within the Thingsboard platform, including resource management and statistics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up script parser configuration, executor, and warms up the TBEL engine.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service and performs cleanup.

methods.name: isScriptPresent
methods.description: Checks if a script with the given UUID is present.

methods.name: isExecEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TBEL script execution is enabled for a tenant.

methods.name: reportExecution
methods.description: Reports script execution metrics for billing or monitoring.

methods.name: doEvalScript
methods.description: Compiles and caches a script, associates it with a script ID, and prepares it for execution.

methods.name: doInvokeFunction
methods.description: Executes a compiled script with provided arguments within a sandboxed execution context.

methods.name: doRelease
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a script ID, invalidating cache and removing references.

methods.name: compileScript
methods.description: Compiles a script body into a serializable expression using MVEL.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a hash for a script body and its argument names for caching purposes.

methods.name: getMaxEvalRequestsTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for script evaluation requests.

methods.name: getStatsType
methods.description: Returns the statistics type associated with this service.
